notes.title: MAJOR BUG FIX
notes.notes: A lot of customers have been complaining about a couple of bugs and I have made sure to remove and patch and known bugs so that people can enjoy the game. MULTIPLE BUGS HAVE BEEN PATCHED! I pay lot's of attention to the user reviews and discussions so be sure to leave one.
